action: Android developers: register your apps and verify your identity with Google before the January 2027 rollout reaches your region.
exec: Developers who distribute Android apps outside the Play Store will need verified registration from January 2027.
plain: Google says its Android developer verification will begin rolling out worldwide in January 2027, so apps from unverified developers will be harder to install.

key_findings: Google says the global rollout begins in January 2027 with seven app distributors.
Protections went live on September 30 in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand.
Google says millions of apps have been registered, representing over 99% of Android app installs globally.
recommendations: Register apps and verify identity before the rollout reaches your region.

summary: Google announced on 19 November that its Android developer verification will begin a global rollout in January 2027, with Google Play, Galaxy Store, Honor, Oppo, Xiaomi, Transsion and Vivo. Protections went live on 30 September in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand. Google says the apps registered represent over 99% of Android app installs globally. Security.NL adds that power users can still install unregistered apps through an advanced flow.
title: Google to roll out Android developer verification worldwide from January 2027

validation.note: Google's own blog post and Security.NL read; Golem page returned only a cookie wall.
